members.name: volatility_contraction_breakout_v1
members.thesis: When ATR(14) on 1-min bars contracts to below the 20th percentile of its session distribution, it signals a volatility squeeze that precedes a directional breakout. This is the intraday equivalent of daily ATR contraction patterns. The mechanism is that low ATR indicates temporary equilibrium betwee
entry_long: ATR_pctile < 20 within last 5 bars (squeeze recently occurred)
bar_range > ATR_14 * 1.5 (expansion bar — range exceeds recent ATR)
members.exit_target: 2.0 * ATR_14 (measured from the squeeze range, using pre-squeeze ATR for calibration)
members.exit_stop: opposite side of squeeze range (if long, stop at squeeze low; if short, stop at squeeze high)
filters: India_VIX < 22; VIX squeeze + ATR squeeze is a strong setup
no entries before 10:00 (need session data for percentile) or after 14:30
expansion bar volume > 2x 20-bar SMA (genuine breakout, not drift)
VWAP alignment required
bid-ask spread < 0.05%
weaknesses: Not all ATR squeezes resolve with directional breakouts — some simply continue as low-vol drift (no expansion)
The 10-bar minimum squeeze requirement may miss shorter compression patterns that also lead to valid breakouts
Using the squeeze range as stop means the stop distance varies — can be very tight (good) or very wide (bad) depending on the squeeze

members.name: vol_breakout_squeeze_v1
members.thesis: Volatility cycles between contraction and expansion phases. When ATR(14) on 1-min bars contracts to its 120-bar minimum AND the Bollinger Band width percentile drops below 10 (dual squeeze), the subsequent expansion phase produces tradeable breakouts that are 40% more likely to follow through than b
entry_long: dual_squeeze was True within last 5 bars
entry_short: dual_squeeze was True within last 5 bars
members.exit_stop: price re-enters squeeze range midpoint OR 0.25% from entry
filters: none (squeeze/expansion works across VIX regimes)
best squeezes form 10:00-13:30 (lunch lull); best expansions 13:30-15:00
expansion bar volume > 1.3x SMA(volume, 20)
none (the squeeze IS the filter — it selects for stocks about to trend)
bid-ask < 0.04% at breakout
weaknesses: The dual squeeze condition (ATR min AND BB width percentile < 10) is restrictive; it may only trigger 2-3 times per stock per day, limiting universe to scanning 50+ stocks
First expansion bar direction is a coin flip unless additional momentum confirmation is used; the direction filter alone has ~55% accuracy
Squeeze ranges are narrow by definition, so the 2x range target may be only 15-25 bps, and after costs the net profit per trade is very thin
members.prior_art: Carter (2012) TTM Squeeze; Bollinger (2001) on bandwidth contraction. Historical volatility cycling from Mandelbrot (1963) and Parkinson (1980).

members.name: bb_squeeze_breakout_v1
members.thesis: When Bollinger Band width compresses to a multi-day low, volatility is coiling and a directional move is imminent. The squeeze resolves into a breakout as accumulated orders fire. The inefficiency exists because many participants interpret tight Bollingers as 'no opportunity' and leave the screen, r
filters: vix between 11-24
no entry first 30 min or last 30 min
breakout bar > 1.5x 20-bar avg
prefer breakout direction aligned with 60-bar EMA slope
skip if spread > 0.1%
weaknesses: Squeeze detection on 1-min bars with 20-bar lookback captures 20-minute squeezes — these are much noisier than daily squeezes. Many false squeezes.

members.name: bollinger_squeeze_v1
members.universe: NIFTY 50 constituents on NSE (top 15 by liquidity)
members.thesis: Bollinger Band width on 1-min bars contracting to its 120-bar minimum signals a volatility squeeze — a coiled spring of compressed price action that tends to release in a directional breakout. On NIFTY 50 stocks, intraday squeezes often occur during the 11:00-13:30 lunch lull, and the subsequent bre
entry_long: squeeze_on has been True for >= 10 bars (genuine compression, not momentary)
mom_slope > 0 (momentum oscillator turning up — likely upside breakout)
entry_short: squeeze_on has been True for >= 10 bars
mom_slope < 0 (momentum oscillator turning down — likely downside breakout)
members.exit_target: 2.5 * (BB_upper - BB_lower at squeeze point) from entry — volatility expansion target
members.exit_stop: price re-enters the squeeze range (closes back between BB_upper and BB_lower) OR 0.3% from entry
filters: India_VIX between 12 and 20 (too low = no breakout energy; too high = noise)
squeeze signals between 10:00-14:30 are best; avoid first 30 min (opening noise)
breakout bar volume > 1.5x SMA(volume, 20)
NIFTY not in extreme trend (> 1.5%) — squeeze breakouts in strong index trends tend to be one-directional
bid-ask < 0.04%
weaknesses: False breakouts are common on 1-min timeframe — the squeeze releases but price reverses within 5-10 bars, triggering the stop loss. Expected ~45% of signals are false breakouts.
The momentum oscillator direction is not a reliable predictor of breakout direction on 1-min bars; random price fluctuations in the squeeze zone can flip mom_slope frequently
During lunch hours (11:30-13:30) when squeezes commonly form, volume is low, making breakout confirmation via volume unreliable
members.prior_art: Bollinger (2001) Bollinger on Bollinger Bands; Carter (2012) TTM Squeeze (Keltner inside Bollinger). Adapted for 1-min Indian equity intraday context.
